title: Ebola Spreads to Haut-Uélé, Fourth DRC Province, as Cases Reach 1,307
detail: Media reports on 29 June 2026 confirmed Ebola had spread to Haut-Uélé, the fourth DRC province affected by the Bundibugyo virus outbreak. One case was detected after an infected person traveled from Bunia, Ituri's capital, into Haut-Uélé and subsequently died. The province, which borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic, sees heavy cross-border trade and movement, raising concern about further international spread. The expansion means the DRC's entire northeast — home to roughly 15 million people — is now affected. By 30 June, DRC's Ministry of Health reported 1,307 total confirmed cases and 377 deaths nationally.

media.caption: DR Congo says 1,307 Ebola cases confirmed, including 377 deaths
